verdict.rationale: The docs show a Copilot cloud agent that works on its own in the background to complete tasks and runs in isolated cloud sandboxes where it can interact with code and tools. You can then review changes, request edits via @copilot on a pull request, and merge. The 'build' and 'deliver for review' parts of the story are covered; testing is only implied by sandbox execution, and nothing shows a demo. Missing for 10: explicit evidence the agent runs or validates tests, any demo or preview artifact for the reviewer, and independent hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end run.
